component.name: DeerAnalysis
component.summary: Fitting and data management tool for DEER spectroscopy

description.p: DeerAnalysis 2026 is a graphical tool for processing dipolar-EPR (DEER) data. It extracts distance distributions from DEER time traces using Tikhonov regularisation, parametric models, and neural-network fitting (DeerNet), powered by DeerLab. It also provides dataset and fit management for comparing multiple measurements.
